blockers.remediation: PostgresDurableCommandStore now returns CLAIMED only when it inserts a new claim row or successfully takes over an expired lease. Any existing unexpired IN_FLIGHT row returns IN_FLIGHT regardless of owner_token, preventing two process instances sharing one owner token from concurrently entering the handler.

GovernedTransferPolicyRegistry now requires an injected AuthorityEvaluator-compatible source of truth and ratification calls it for RatifyTransferPolicy against the exact stored grant. Caller-shaped authorization objects are ignored and cannot manufacture authority.
